[element-gov]
=== `<gov>` Government Report (in a citation)

Container element for the identification information (typically the title and/or an identification number) for a cited governmental report or other government publication.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  gov          (#PCDATA %gov-elements;)*                    >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

(#PCDATA | bold | fixed-case | italic | monospace | num | overline | roman | sans-serif | sc | strike | underline | ruby | sub | sup | named-content | styled-content)*

#### Tagged Sample

##### In a citation
[source,xml]
....
...
<mixed-citation publication-format="print" publication-type="report"
 ><collab>FCC</collab> <gov>Bulletin No. 65</gov> 
 (<month>August</month> <year>1997</year>), 
 <source>Evaluating Compliance with FCC Guidelines for 
  Human Exposure to Radiofrequency Electromagnetic 
  Fields</source>. Available at 
 <uri>http://www.fcc.gov/Bureaus/Engineering_Technology/Documents/bulletins/oet65/oet65.pdf</uri>. 
 [Rule 420Q NOTE]</mixed-citation>
...
....
